reason: Document B wins my trust by showing the exact math for the 572 backers needed at the goal—which prevents the creator from claiming they can pay for 1,500 shipments on a $28k budget—and by honestly acknowledging that 23 ratings isn't a huge crowd. Document A exaggerates the 140 playtests as 'hundreds of tables' and fails to do the math showing how shipping and manufacturing actually fit into the $28,000 goal.
